info.name: Get the rendered Yoast SEO head tags for a URL

params.name: url
params.description: The nacuity.com URL to render head tags for.

items.docs: Returns the SEO `<head>` block Yoast renders for a nacuity.com URL — title, canonical, robots directives, Open Graph and Twitter card tags, and the schema.org JSON-LD graph. Verified to return 200 anonymously. Every other operation in the yoast/v1 namespace returns 401 rest_forbidden without credentials.
